text_only_refusal.template: '{model}' is legacy LTX-Video and cannot continue motion across a clip boundary, so rendering {total_frames} frames would repeat the same ~{clip_frames}-frame clip rather than extend it. Reduce the frame count to {clip_frames} or fewer for one continuous clip, or use LTX-2.3 or LTX-2.5, which carries context into each continuation.
text_only_refusal.comment: The shared sentence protects durable server admission from a manually submitted context-free ephemeral chain. CLI and Studio keep ordinary legacy one-shots as one denoise up to the engine ceiling instead of auto-splitting them at 97 frames. Authored sequences remain valid independent clips.
